title: Backend Engineer, Platform
description: Build and scale the ingestion platform. Java and Go services on Kubernetes, ~40B events/day. You will own service reliability end to end. Looking for 5+ years backend experience; distributed systems background valued. Some exposure to ML infrastructure is a plus but not required.

title: AI Engineer, Applied
description: Ship LLM-backed features in the product. Prompt engineering, evaluation harnesses, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows. We hire strong software engineers and teach the ML; no research background required. Python, FastAPI, Postgres, pgvector.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description: Payments infrastructure. Java, Spring, Kafka. Heavy emphasis on correctness, idempotency, and reconciliation. On-call rotation shared across six engineers. Fully remote within the US.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Train and serve models in production. PyTorch, feature stores, model registries, online/offline skew. Requires prior experience training models, not only consuming APIs. MS or equivalent industry experience.

title: Software Engineer, LLM Tooling
description: Internal tooling for teams building on LLMs: eval harnesses, prompt registries, tracing and observability. Strong Python. If you have built an eval harness before, we want to talk. This role is engineering-heavy and does not require ML research experience.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description: Technical leadership across the storage org. 8+ years required. Java, Rust. Architecture review, mentorship, and cross-team design. Hybrid, three days in office.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Patient-facing web application. React and Node, some Python services. Healthcare domain, HIPAA compliance training provided. Small team, broad ownership.

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description: Customer-facing engineering. Prototype LLM integrations with enterprise customers, then hand them to the product team. Heavy prompt engineering and systems integration. Travel roughly once a month.
